body:
# Atlantís: every wave of the name, restored
Every name in this series was once flattened to fit a keyboard. **Atlantís** is what the evidence put back.

Atlantís is Plato's story, whether invented or adapted from older traditions. It serves as a philosophical allegory about the corruption of power and the fragility of civilization. Solon visits Egypt and hears from a priest that Athens once defeated a great Atlantic power nine thousand years earlier.  The Greeks have forgotten because catastrophes repeatedly destroy their records, while Egypt's memory is preserved by the Nile's stability.

That is the figure this file is about — and the temple now standing at its restored name.
## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Atlantís
- **ASCII form:** atlantis
- **Meaning:** "Daughter of Atlas; the legendary lost island civilization"
- **Domain of influence:** Lost Island, Legendary Realm, Sea
- **Pantheon:** Greek-location
- **Classification:** Tier 2
- **Original script:** Ἀτλαντίς
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 44 of 271
## The Name Before the Marks

The name is attested as **Ἀτλαντίς**. On the evidence, it means "Daughter of Atlas; the legendary lost island civilization".

Strip **Atlantís** to *atlantis* and one piece of evidence vanishes:

- **i → í** — Acute on iota: the stress position the ASCII form cannot show.

A reader who knows the marks hears the name correctly on the first try. A reader who never sees them never gets the chance.
## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Atlantís** lives at [/sites/atlantis/](/sites/atlantis/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/sites/atlantis/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/sites/atlantis/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/sites/atlantis/patterns/).

The restoration preserves one decisive feature the ASCII form drops — a single, honest mark — which places it in Tier-2: exact, and exactly labeled.

Every flagship temple is hand-built to the same standard: the original script displayed with its provenance, the pronunciation reconstructed phoneme by phoneme, the sources named — because a restoration you cannot audit is just a spelling with confidence.
## The Archetype at Work

A temple is also a reading of what this figure *means* — and meanings have addresses in the modern world. The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) maps **Atlantís** to the industries its archetype genuinely resonates with, each match argued, weighted, and open to challenge:

- **Travel, Tourism & Place Branding** — The lost island; resorts already bear the name.
- **Architecture & Spatial Design** — Concentric rings of land and water; the engineered capital that haunts city planning.
- **Disaster Resilience & Recovery** — The city the sea took in a day and a night; the founding parable of catastrophic loss.

The mapping is conservative on purpose: only resonances that can be argued aloud. The rest of the atlas follows the same rule, industry by industry.
## The File Continues

This is one of 271 Restoration Files — a second dispatch from every flagship temple in the fleet. The temple's [first dispatch](/sites/atlantis/blog/) tells the founding story of the name; the [blog index](/blog/) holds the whole archive.

Continue the series — previous file: **ʾAṯiratu** ([read it here](/sites/athiratu/blog/restoration/)) · next file: **Átlas** ([read it here](/sites/atlas/blog/restoration/)).

*The Restoration Files are written from the same canonical record as the temples themselves: the lexicon, the lore catalog, the pattern atlas, and the cited scholarly sources. If a file ever disagrees with its temple, the temple is right — tell us, and the file will be corrected.*
